faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Maine Coon?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 9-18 lb (4-8 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Maine Coon?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) risk; Dental disease; Obesity if indoor-idle. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Maine Coon at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Maine Coon, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
